title: COPD exacerbation, home; diagnosis, med list, follow-up and PCP all present under nonstandard headers and abbreviations

rationale.final_diagnosis: The discharge diagnoses are listed under 'Impression at Discharge', a common synonym the section list does not include; the content is complete.
rationale.discharge_meds: A full dosed discharge medication list appears under the abbreviated header 'Meds at d/c'.
rationale.followup: Follow-up is in a 'Plan' paragraph: PMD Dr. Ostrowski in 1 wk and pulmonary clinic with Dr. Wielicki in 4-6 wks; who and when are both stated.
rationale.pcp_named: The primary care clinician is named as 'her PMD, Dr. Nadia Ostrowski' with a phone number; PMD is a standard synonym for PCP.
rationale.pac_list: Home without new services, so the post-acute rules do not apply.
